T: If he dies, he dies. If you're hungry, eat.
D: Rocky travels to the Soviet Union to fight the giant boxer who killed his friend.
P: Serve the mains when Rocky starts training in the Siberian snow.
S: Buckwheat pancakes with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill
Buckwheat and plain flour batter with yeast and milk, rested an hour, cooked small in butter, topped with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill.
Whole cucumbers brined 4 days with garlic and dill, served with buttered rye
Cucumbers packed into jars with garlic, dill, peppercorns and a hot salted brine, left on the bench 4 days to ferment sour, served with rye bread and butter.
Paulie's birthday present, the talking robot

Chocolate cake crumbled into cream cheese frosting, rolled into balls and dipped in silver-tinted white chocolate on sticks, with silver cachous for eyes. Bake a chocolate cake from 200g self-raising flour, 40g cocoa, 200g sugar, 2 eggs, 125ml oil and 250ml milk at 175C for 35 minutes, then cool. Crumble and mix with 125g cream cheese beaten with 60g icing sugar. Roll into 20 balls, push in sticks and chill 1 hour. Melt 300g white chocolate, dip each pop, dust with edible silver lustre and press on 2 silver cachous for eyes.
M: a hot bowl after chopping wood in the snow

Beef shin simmered with beetroot, cabbage, carrot and potato into a deep red soup, sharpened with vinegar, with sour cream, dill and buttered rye. Simmer 800g beef shin in 2L water with a bay leaf for 2 hours, then shred the meat back into the broth. Soften a diced onion and carrot, add 3 grated beetroot and 2 tbsp tomato paste and cook 10 minutes. Add to the pot with 2 diced potatoes and a quarter of a cabbage, shredded, and simmer 25 minutes. Stir in 2 tbsp red wine vinegar and season. Serve with sour cream, dill and buttered rye bread.
Boiled Russian beef and pork dumplings tossed in butter

Beef and pork mince with grated onion and pepper wrapped in thin dough, boiled 5 minutes until they float, tossed in butter with dill and a spoon of sour cream. Mix 300g flour, 1 egg and 125ml water into a firm dough and rest. Mix 250g beef mince, 250g pork mince and 1 grated onion. Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal. Boil 5 minutes, toss in 50g butter and dill, serve with sour cream.
W: Buttery walnut cookies rolled twice in powdered sugar

Buttery walnut shortbread balls baked pale and rolled twice in icing sugar until they look like snowballs, served with strong black tea. Beat 225g butter with 60g icing sugar and vanilla, then mix in 280g plain flour and 100g finely chopped walnuts. Roll into 30 balls and bake at 180C for 14 minutes. Roll in icing sugar while warm, then again when cool.
K: Vodka, cranberry juice, lime and ginger beer over crushed ice

Freezer-cold vodka with cranberry juice, fresh lime and spicy ginger beer over crushed ice, with frozen cranberries and a sprig of rosemary. Keep the vodka in the freezer overnight. Fill four copper mugs or tumblers with crushed ice. Add to each 45ml vodka, 45ml cranberry juice and the juice of half a lime. Top with 120ml cold ginger beer and stir once. Drop in a few frozen cranberries and a rosemary sprig.

note.text: Eat up. After dinner I'm hauling logs through the snow, and someone has to beat the big Russian.

winks: Logs and a sled in the Siberian snow

dishes.make_ahead: Batter can rest up to 2 hours

steps.text: Mix both flours, yeast and warm milk into a batter and rest until bubbly.
Cook small spoonfuls in butter in a pan until golden on both sides.
Top each with sour cream, a curl of smoked salmon and dill.
Pack the cucumbers into a jar with the garlic, dill and peppercorns.
Stir the salt into the water until dissolved and pour over to cover.
Leave on the bench for 4 days until sour.
Serve with buttered rye bread.

dishes.make_ahead: Freeze uncooked dumplings for up to 1 month

steps.text: Mix the flour, egg and water into a firm dough, knead and rest under a bowl.
Grate the onion and mix with both minces and some salt and pepper.
Roll the dough thin, cut rounds, fill and seal each one.
Boil in salted water until they float and are cooked through.
Toss in the butter and dill and serve with sour cream.

dishes.make_ahead: Keeps 5 days in an airtight tin

steps.text: Beat the butter with some of the icing sugar and the vanilla until pale.
Mix in the flour and finely chopped walnuts, then roll into balls.
Bake at 180C until set and lightly golden.
Roll in icing sugar while warm, cool, then roll again.
Keep the vodka in the freezer overnight.
Fill four mugs with crushed ice and add vodka, cranberry juice and lime juice to each.
Top with cold ginger beer and stir once.
Drop in frozen cranberries and a rosemary sprig.

s.note: Buckwheat pancakes with sour cream, smoked salmon and dill
s.how: Mix 100g buckwheat flour, 100g plain flour, 7g yeast and 300ml warm milk and rest an hour. Cook small spoonfuls in butter until golden. Top each with sour cream, a curl of smoked salmon and dill.

s.note: Whole cucumbers brined 4 days with garlic and dill, served with buttered rye
s.how: Pack 1kg small cucumbers into a jar with 4 garlic cloves, dill and 1 tsp peppercorns. Pour over a cooled brine of 1L water and 50g salt. Leave on the bench for 4 days until sour. Serve with buttered rye bread.
